mapper.insert: insert into bus_bpmn_info (bpmn_label, bpmn_type, process_definition_key, deploy_time, version, info) values (#{bpmnLabel}, #{bpmnType}, #{processDefinitionKey}, #{deployTime}, #{version}, #{info})
mapper.update: update bus_bpmn_info set bpmn_label = #{bpmnLabel}, bpmn_type = #{bpmnType}, process_definition_key = #{processDefinitionKey}, deploy_time = #{deployTime}, version = #{version}, info = #{info} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, bpmn_label, bpmn_type, process_definition_key, deploy_time, version, info from bus_bpmn_info
select id, bpmn_label, bpmn_type, process_definition_key, deploy_time, version, info from bus_bpmn_info where bpmn_type = #{auditType} order by version desc limit 1
